component.name: fop
component.title: FOP
component.description: Render XSL-FO documents into PDF, PostScript, PNG and other output formats with Apache FOP.
component.label: file,transformation

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelFop.Output.Format.description: The output format of this message, which overrides the outputType of the endpoint. Either a name, such as pdf or png, or a MIME type that Apache FOP supports, such as application/pdf, which is passed to FOP as is.

producerIn.description: The XSL-FO document to render, as text, bytes, a stream, a file, a DOM Document or a javax.xml.transform.Source. A Map or no body fails

producerOut.description: The rendered document as bytes, in a ByteArrayOutputStream: PDF, or the outputType, or the format of the CamelFop.Output.Format header

outputType.description: The output format to render to. The endpoint URI takes the lower-case name, such as pdf or png, or the MIME type, such as application/pdf. The CamelFop.Output.Format header overrides it for a single message.

fopFactory.description: A custom org.apache.fop.apps.FopFactory to render with, for example one built in Java code with FopFactoryBuilder. It cannot be combined with userConfigURL. If neither is set, a FopFactory with the default FOP settings is created.

userConfigURL.description: The location of an Apache FOP configuration file (such as fop.xconf), for example to set the resolution, the default page size or the fonts. Use the classpath:, file: or http: prefix; without a prefix the file is loaded from the classpath. It cannot be combined with fopFactory.
